stdout:
usage: backlog.py promote [-h] [--dir DIR] [--title TITLE] [--id ID]
                          [--version VERSION] [--into INTO]
                          ids [ids ...]

positional arguments:
  ids

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR          Project directory (default: current; the Git root is
                     used)
  --title TITLE      Plan title (default: the item's title; required for
                     several items)
  --id ID            Plan id (default: generated from the title)
  --version VERSION  Target version
  --into INTO        Add the items to this existing plan instead
